# Email Sequences - welcome, nurture, launch

Curated by Skill Harbor: one sub-skill of the MIT ai-marketing-claude suite (zubair-trabzada, not the rediumvex same-name pack). You give it a topic or product, audience, offer, and sequence type; it generates a complete email sequence as editable drafts, in order, with subject lines. It writes drafts only: it does not send email, does not connect to your mailing tool, and needs no account. Sequence lengths are the SKILL.md ranges: Welcome 5-7, Nurture 6-8, Launch 8-12, plus Re-engagement 3-4, Onboarding 5-7, Cart 3-4, Cold 3-5. This fiche covers ONLY skills/market-emails/ (SKILL.md only at the pinned commit). It does NOT install the market orchestrator, the agents, or any other sub-skill. Prerequisites for this skill: none. Do not run install.sh, and never use ~/.claude/skills for this Muse install. You review, edit, and send yourself; nothing is sent by this skill.
